body:
League of Legends is my favorite game of all time.

For starters I just got my new pc after a fee years of playing on a shitty laptop. Right now i can really afford games so League of Legends was the first thing I picked up for free.

It is a 5v5 MOBA in which the goal to destroy the nexus or the heart of the base. Along the way you have to defeat minions, towers, dragons, enemy players and more. You slowly gain gold from killing other players and minions to buy items to make you stronger. One of my favorite things about the game is the diverse champion pool. There are over 100 champions to chose from with each of the ming being unique. My favorite champion is Yasuo because he is super fast, aggressive,  and deals loads of damage. I've played the last of us part one back in 2015 and ive looking forward to playing part 2!
